subject: empty reefer Newark Thurs - need a load west
body:
Good afternoon,

We'll have a 53' reefer empty in Newark NJ Thursday 11/19 after a drop at Tri-State Crossdock. Driver wants to head west, Chicago/Rockford area ideally, PA or OH works too.

Looking for $2.15/mi on anything decent. Can run dry if needed.
